name: agent402
description: Agent402 is the payment and trust layer for agentic commerce: agents find, pay for and verify paid calls to Agent402, across x402 and MPP, with signed receipts on successful direct calls. 500+ ready tools on the same rails. Open-source MCP server and skill: web search and rendering, PDFs, OCR, SEC filings, market and crypto data, and utilities, paid in USDC over x402 or MPP, or free via proof-of-work for pure-compute tools. Most tools are deterministic code; model-backed tools are marked as such.
